_comment: Milestone 1 session catalogue. Read by harness/coverage.mjs (a placement only counts once its session exists here) and driven live by harness/session.mjs, which loads the dist/ build in a real browser. `chapter-NN` is one story chapter per SGK unit, carrying that unit's grammar, pronunciation, Everyday English function, culture block and writing genre. `vocab-spiral-A-B` interleaves the lexis of two adjacent units instead of teaching each unit's word list in place, so the vocabulary track is its own cross-cutting session rather than one more slot in a 12x7 grid. Only chapter-01 has authored prose and a browser-driven page today (content/chapters/chapter-01.md, dist/chapter-1.html); the remaining ids are real catalogue entries scheduled for the sessions that place their targets, and are the next cycle's work.
